2. `[C2E2]` - After the clef change to treble, this is a chord with C and E. In treble clef with no octave modifiers, these would be C4 and E4.

The lowest note is `C,` which, starting from bass clef, represents C2 in scientific pitch notation.

{"answer": "C2"}
